title: Regioselective rapid ene-type reaction (RRER) enables bioconjugation of histone serotonylation
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,1278-1283
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00159E, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jinghua Wu, Huapeng Li, Adam R. Lovato, Andrew Symasek, Zeng Lin, Qingfei Zheng
A pH-controlled regioselective rapid ene-type reaction (RRER) was developed for the specific bioconjugation of a novel epigenetic mark, histone serotonylation, where the triazolinedione (TAD) derivative was employed as a chemical biology probe.
